faqs.a:
Section 305.1. General,
is hereby amended in its entirety to read as follows.
"
305.1. General.
The interior of a structure and equipment therein shall be maintained structurally
                  sound and in a sanitary condition. Occupants shall keep that part of the structure
                  which they occupy or control in sanitary condition. Every owner of a structure containing
                  a rooming house, housekeeping units, a hotel, a dormitory, two or more dwelling units
                  or two or more nonresidential occupancies, shall maintain, in sanitary condition,
                  the shared or public areas of the structure and exterior property."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 12, 9-14-2020)
